title: Customs clearance update
description: Inform recipients that a shipment is held at customs and which document or fee is needed. Utility template for international carriers.
notes: Name the exact action required and deadline. It is a high-value utility message because delays cost money.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, shipment *{{tracking}}* is currently held at customs. To release it we need {{requirement}} by {{deadline}}. Please upload it as soon as you can.
